card.text: Explore 162P/Siding Spring through a shape approximation based on published lightcurve models.

introduction.text: Siding Spring has a large, elongated nucleus and rotates once in about thirty-three hours. Its thickness is less certain than its length.

model.title: Inferred shape
model.summary: A smooth approximation of the published proportions. Its thickness is uncertain. The grid marks missing surface imagery; it does not show terrain. Rotation phase is illustrative.
